title: Cut out the middle
starter:
%x  = buffer 16 dtype=f32 slot=0
%y  = buffer 4 dtype=f32 slot=1
%v  = load %x
%m  = reshape %v [4 4]
%w  = shrink %m 0 0 [2 2]
%f  = reshape %w [4]
%s  = store %y %f
%y1 = after %y %s
hints: The starter's window has the right shape, `[2 2]`, but it sits in the top left corner.
The two numbers before the shape are the offsets: how many rows to skip, then how many columns.
The middle starts one row down and one column in: `shrink %m 1 1 [2 2]`.
explain: `shrink %m 1 1 [2 2]` skips one row and one column, then keeps a 2 by 2 window, so element `[i][j]` of the result reads `m[i + 1][j + 1]`. On the grid `0..15` that is `5 6` over `9 10`. The offsets say where the window starts and the list says how big it is.
